# About Me

<!--
Background for the assistant: the things email and calendar can't tell it.

- Write freely. Full sentences, bullet points, whatever is easiest. Skip any
  section that doesn't apply, and add sections that are missing.
- Later, a local model on the Mac will turn this into data/profile.yaml, and
  you'll approve each entry before it's saved.
- Facts about you go in sections 1-7. How the assistant should behave goes in
  section 8.
- The filled-in copy is personal data. Keep it in data/, never in docs/.
-->

Last updated: YYYY-MM-DD

<!-- Name you go by, where you live, household members, time zone, anything
you'd tell a new assistant on their first day. -->

<!-- Weekly rhythms, standing appointments, school or activity schedules,

## 5. Priorities: what deserves attention

<!-- Senders, topics, or kinds of messages that should always reach you
